overallVerdict: Lacks required Daniel Li film-room freezes, slow-mo breakdowns, and contains redundant close-up replay loops.

topProblems.problem: Missing clock freeze at 3.7s and rightward attack slow-mo as described in VO.
topProblems.fix: Add freeze frame at 3.7s catch, highlight defender stance, and apply 50% slow-mo on rightward drive.

topProblems.problem: Behind-the-back counter and left gather happen too fast; clip desyncs from VO narrative.
topProblems.fix: Insert slow-mo on behind-the-back move and freeze on leftward gather window.

topProblems.problem: Close-up replay is shown twice back-to-back without added analytical value.
topProblems.fix: Remove second close-up repeat at 00:31; hold baseline angle for make/contact, then cut to reaction.

timelineFixes.whatIsOnScreen: Wide shot of inbound pass and catch.
timelineFixes.problem: Plays in real time without pausing on catch.
timelineFixes.exactFix: Freeze frame at 00:04 when clock hits 3.7s during catch.

timelineFixes.whatIsOnScreen: Clark drives right towards half court.
timelineFixes.problem: Pacing is too fast; rightward setup passes before VO finishes.
timelineFixes.exactFix: Apply 50% slow-mo to rightward attack and freeze when defender opens stance.

timelineFixes.whatIsOnScreen: Clark behind-the-back counter and pull-up shot.
timelineFixes.problem: Behind-the-back counter and left gather complete prematurely.
timelineFixes.exactFix: Slow down behind-the-back cross; freeze at release point to emphasize shot window.

timelineFixes.whatIsOnScreen: Wide angle finish cutting to close-up contact angle.
timelineFixes.problem: Close-up cuts in while VO is still discussing shot gathering.
timelineFixes.exactFix: Sync close-up angle to match contact VO at 00:28.

timelineFixes.whatIsOnScreen: Wide angle make repeated then close-up angle repeated.
timelineFixes.exactFix: Cut redundant repeat; show wide make once, then single close-up contact frame.
Keep reaction clip, trim slightly to end sharply on VO finish.

clipReuseAudit.reason: Identical close-up repeated twice without new graphic or analysis.

sourceOrGameRepetitionProblems.problem: Single possession play repeated across full clip.
sourceOrGameRepetitionProblems.fix: Acceptable for single-play breakdown, but requires analytical freeze frames to justify duration.

recommendedRepairOrder: Add freeze frame at 3.7s inbound catch.
Apply slow-mo to rightward drive and behind-the-back counter.
Add freeze frame at leftward release point.
